markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (94%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set supports InSitu [F1], but Tier 1 frozen-section margins are positive [F12].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 94%, Invasive 6%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong InSitu lead over Invasive |
| Conformal set | InSitu (90% target; test 90%, CI 76%–98%) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 92nd percentile OOD, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Input passes quality checks |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match top class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5]; closest 2 Invasive (88%, 87%) | Mixed; two closest are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.46 SD) adds +0.41; 0/20 check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Typical infiltrate (+0.23 contribution); 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Low overall (-0.20), but peaks in region 2 (+0.60) [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · High score (+0.54 SD) lowers risk (-0.18; 18/20 check) · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 2, 9, 11) · context · 81% neoplastic nuclei (99th percentile) [F7], mostly regions 2, 9 · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); top concept normal lobules (0/20 check) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in region 2 (84% risk) or 9 (60% risk), matching the two closest Invasive neighbors.
- High OOD percentile (92nd) or calibration error (ECE 5%, CI 4%–22%, n=132) underestimates focal invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 9**: Highest invasive risk (84%, 60%) and tumor density (97th percentile [F8]); rule out invasion.
2. **Regions 4, 6, 10**: Strongest duct-confined and tubule scores; confirm in situ confinement and check positive margins.
3. **Region 11**: Only 1 neoplastic nucleus (34 connective); verify benign stroma versus unreliable normal-lobules score.
